### Features

******

### Usage

******

#### [ 1 ] - Obtain the declarations (d.ts) directory

Get the directory from NPM or GitHub.

##### Get it from NPM (recommended)

```shell
npm i @sm003/autojs6-dts
```

After installation, locate `/node_modules/@sm003/autojs6-dts/declarations`.

##### Get it from GitHub

[Download the latest project zip archive](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs6-TypeScript-Declarations/archive/main.zip) and extract the `declarations` directory.

#### [ 2 ] - Place the declarations directory

> Skip this step when using WebStorm.

Place the directory anywhere inside your project.

For a project named `hello`, suppose the directory structure is:

> hello / images / ...
> hello / docs / ...
> hello / main.js
> hello / project.json
> ... ...

The `declarations` directory can then be placed as follows:

> hello / declarations / (recommended)
> hello / images / declarations /
> hello / docs / declarations /
> hello / ... / ... / declarations /

It cannot be placed alongside the project or in a parent directory.

#### [ 3 ] - Enable or improve code completion

The development tool automatically discovers and indexes all declaration files.

After indexing, start coding with completion suggestions.

> Note: some editors need to restart before indexing declarations.

#### [ 4 ] - Additional configuration for VSCode

Unlike WebStorm, VSCode may not recognize the declarations directory in every location. In particular, a declarations directory deployed with npm may not be discovered by VSCode by default. Copy [jsconfig.json](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs6-TypeScript-Declarations/blob/main/jsconfig.json) into the project root, for example:

> hello / node_modules / @sm003 / autojs6-dts / ...
> hello / jsconfig.json
> hello / main.js
> ... ...

If the project already has jsconfig.json, merge the following configuration into it:

```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "typeRoots": [
      "./node_modules/@sm003/autojs6-dts/declarations",
      "./declarations"
    ]
  }
}
```

Restart VSCode to enable or improve code completion for `hello/main.js` in this example.

******

### Updates

******

Get updates directly from NPM:

```shell
npm update @sm003/autojs6-dts
```

To check for updates, visit the [project homepage](http://dts-project.autojs6.com), or open package.json at the project root and hover over the version of the @sm003/autojs6-dts dependency to see available updates. VSCode can also use [Version Lens](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=pflannery.vscode-versionlens) to check for updates.

The declarations are usually updated alongside new releases of [AutoJs6](http://autojs6.com).

## Changelog

### v4.36.0

###### 2026/10/08

##### Compose UI fragment reuse

* `Feature` compose.memo and ComposeMemoOptions reuse node fragments in render when dependency values and read state values are unchanged, with key-based list item matching
* `Hint` Requires matching host 6.8.0 / 5323; dependency comparison, slot matching, call timing and the 256-dependency limit are validated at runtime. TSX requires matching TypeScript Engine 0.6.8 and Ace Editor 1.30.0

### v4.35.0

###### 2026/10/08

##### Compose UI contract V2

* `Feature` 25 node factories and TSX tags for navigation bars/drawers, tabs, bottom sheets, menus, date/time pickers, pagers, grids, Chip, Badge, segmented buttons, floating buttons, search, Tooltip and pull-to-refresh
* `Improvement` V2 properties, default read values, required slots, child types and event arguments generated directly from the append-only contract catalog, preserving frozen V1 and the separate F2 interoperability catalog
* `Hint` New components require matching host 5322 and a contract V2 rendering plugin; TSX requires TypeScript Engine 0.6.7 and Ace Editor 1.29.0. Numeric ranges, child counts and cross-property constraints remain runtime-validated

### v4.34.0

###### 2026/10/07

##### Compose UI dialogs

* `Feature` compose.dialog and DialogOptions / DialogType support standalone dialogs and bottom sheets, returning the existing ComposeSession
* `Improvement` Precise alert / bottomSheet types, cancelable and theme overrides, preserving synchronous root input and existing session methods
* `Hint` Requires matching host 5321 and Compose UI supporting dialog-v1; TSX requires matching TypeScript Engine 0.6.6. Non-UI scripts must already have overlay permission; it is not requested automatically

[Full changelog](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs6-TypeScript-Declarations/blob/main/.changelog/CHANGELOG-en.md)
